name: streetsempire-desktop
description: Cross-platform StreetsEmpire desktop game with opt-in Discord Rich Presence

scripts.check: node --check src/main.cjs && node --check src/discord-ipc.cjs && node --check src/activity.cjs
scripts.dist:portable: npm run prepare:config && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run prepare:config && electron-builder --mac zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run prepare:config && electron-builder --mac zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run prepare:config && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never

linux.synopsis: Play StreetsEmpire with Discord Rich Presence
